{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVQjdzc8AAAABZeLBKg", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn3IVzhDFXZg", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn3IV", "number": 35, "title": "Consume VDP2 rotation parameter reload requests once at the raster read boundary", "body": "## Problem

Related to #17

At `859cc4d8e6bdd37c054076726dae8d86376cd143`, `Vdp2::read_rotation_line` tests the six RPRCTL reload bits on every line but never clears them. A single guest request therefore repeatedly reloads Xst, Yst or KAst instead of allowing subsequent vertical accumulation. This can freeze rotation origins or repeatedly reset coefficient-table addressing.

For example, initialize Xst=10 and ΔXst=1. Before line 1, write Xst=100 and request its reload once. Line 1 should start at 100 and line 2 at 101 without another request. The current code instead reloads 100 on line 2; another table write can unexpectedly move that line again.

The existing `parameter_reload_strobes_are_independent_and_accumulate_current_deltas` test explicitly writes RPRCTL=0 before its later accumulation assertion. It consequently cannot detect the missing automatic clear. The existing sprite-rotation fixture also leaves requests asserted while expecting repeated reloads.

## Expected outcome

Implement the complete one-shot lifetime of all six RPRCTL requests, integrated with the existing raster-driven rotation parameter reads and shared by rotation backgrounds and rotated sprite readout.

The affirmative primary contract is [Sega VDP2 User's Manual ST-058-R2, §6.3, printed pp.157–158](https://antime.kapsi.fi/sega/files/ST-058-R2-060194.pdf): each selected parameter is read at the next rotation-parameter read, and its enable bit clears simultaneously. Reloading every line requires writing the request every line. The [later Sega HTML manual, §6.3, RPRCTL description and final paragraph](https://www.infochunk.com/saturn/segahtml_en/hard/vdp2/hon/p06_31.htm) states the same rule explicitly. Bits 0/1/2 select A Xst/Yst/KAst; bits 8/9/10 select B Xst/Yst/KAst.

Use [§6.3's start-coordinate accumulation equations](https://www.infochunk.com/saturn/segahtml_en/hard/vdp2/hon/p06_30.htm), §6.4 coefficient addressing, and §6.3 p.159 sprite-rotation linkage for downstream expectations. Preserve independent starts, current vertical deltas, signed widths and field initialization.

Keep this increment focused on request consumption and its observable consequences. Full rotation VRAM acquisition timing, general VDP2 register-read semantics and unrelated rendering changes remain separate work. RPRCTL is write-only; guest validation must demonstrate the effect through pixels and computed records rather than assume readable request bits.

## Context and reproduction

Relevant implementation:

- `src/vdp2/rotation.rs:37–77`: reads requests and updates starts without consuming requests.
- `src/vdp2.rs:193–208,244–249`: normal line-start and initial/fallback parameter-read paths.
- `src/vdp2/tables.rs:49–54`: retained A/B parameter tables.
- `src/bus.rs:632–678`: raster events precede equal-clock external transaction completion.

Relevant evidence requiring extension:

- `src/vdp2/rotation.rs:436–503`: existing independence test manually clears RPRCTL at line 487.
- `tests/fixtures/build_sprite_rotation.py:49–52`, `tests/sprite_rotation.rs`, and `scripts/browser-smoke.mjs`: existing raster-driven sprite guests and framebuffer/Canvas assertions.
- `tests/rbg1.rs`, `tests/video_effects.rs`, and `tests/video_scanout.rs`: background, coefficient and sprite linkage regressions.
- `docs/hardware-conformance.md:1705–1730`: historical reload evidence does not establish automatic consumption.

The supplied current snapshot has no open task Issues. Main's build observation is in progress, with no conclusion; it is neither failure nor passing evidence. Planning used read-only inspection and primary specifications; complete suites were not rerun.

## Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- [ ] Implement consumption of each selected request at the corresponding rotation-parameter read. Subsequent lines accumulate without a host or guest clear. Reissuing a request reloads again. Writes and debugger rendering must not themselves consume requests, and repeated rendering of one line must not consume a later request.
- [ ] Add independent native sequence vectors for all six individual bits and mixed A/B requests. Check several consecutive lines after one write, table mutations after consumption, independently changed deltas, rearming, signed boundaries, first-line initialization, both interlace field parities and reset. Include the literal 10→100→101 distinguishing sequence. Expected values must not call production rotation helpers.
- [ ] Add focused scheduled-bus tests through both SH-2 adapters for RPRCTL writes completing before, at and after a line-read boundary. Preserve and document the existing equal-edge ordering as an emulator convention, without claiming measured electrical timing. Repeat with advancement chunks 1/3/17/10000 and intervening debugger inspection; assert identical starts and pixels and cancellation of stale pending writes on reset.
- [ ] Add reproducible original MIT-licensed SH-2 guest coverage that writes actual tables/MMIO and distinguishes one request, no request and requests reissued on successive lines. Demonstrate A/B background origins, KAst-driven coefficient selection and rotated sprite readout, with independently authored framebuffer expectations. Include changed table/delta operands and repeated cold boots. Host code may load, advance and inspect, but must not supply computed results or pixels.
- [ ] Run the same diagnostic bytes through production Wasm in the existing headless browser workflow under `/saturn-rust/`; assert guest records, framebuffer pixels and actual Canvas pixels. The unchanged implementation must fail a distinguishing native sequence and guest assertion; record the actual negative-control results.
- [ ] Preserve existing tests and Star Collector, Prism Courier and Hardware Lab. Where historical rotation fixtures relied on sticky requests, correct the guest sequence or oracle with exact primary references and rationale, retaining equivalent substantive coverage and adding the missing one-shot checks. Do not delete assertions merely to obtain passing results.
- [ ] Update the conformance matrix and validation record with the corrected contract, implementation/test links, reproducible fixture hashes, actual check results and remaining deviations. Evidence-backed corrections to this AI-authored task may be documented autonomously; they must preserve the fixed goal and independent validation.
- [ ] Pass `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo build --locked`, `cargo test --locked`, native and Wasm Clippy with warnings denied, all registered fixture/media reproduction checks, `sh scripts/build-web.sh`, and the complete extended `npm run test:browser`, without skipping required regressions.

This is a partial #17 improvement. Remaining CPU/peripheral, multiprocessor/bus/reset, SCU/DSP, video/audio, CD/media/HLE, SMPC and comprehensive integration requirements remain mandatory. Leave #17's unmet criteria unresolved and do not reopen historical trackers. Commercial-game compatibility remains unverified.

## Optional validation

None required. Personal firmware, commercial media, physical hardware, human approval and live Pages inspection are not acceptance gates.
